assets.name: evening
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original cinematic architectural background for a functional quiet storytelling app, landscape 1536 × 1024.
Primary request: A believable modest high-rise apartment looking out through tall thin black steel window mullions across a dense fictional contemporary city and broad urban waterfront at blue hour in light drizzle.
Scene/backdrop: A panoramic window spans nearly the whole frame. Broad calm water occupies the middle distance from x=30% to x=80%. The opposite bank has warm dock lights and a low distant elevated railway. The skyline consists of varied ordinary contemporary apartment and office buildings, entirely original architecture with no recognizable landmark replicas. Faint rain beads on glass, gentle atmospheric depth, fine restrained film grain.
Foreground: A warm walnut writing desk occupies the lower right, extending from x=56% to the right edge, with an empty slightly angled chair partly silhouetted near x=70%, a closed notebook and a simple ceramic mug. Modest restrained cozy room, very little clutter. The lower quarter of the entire frame is a quiet dark interior foreground and subdued desktop, suitable for overlaid narration.
Composition/framing: Photograph at seated eye level, 28mm architectural lens, level verticals. Tall thin black mullions around x=18%, x=44%, and x=78%; no thick central frame blocking the main view. Window horizon at roughly y=42%. Skyline and water remain clearly visible through the central x=35–70% vertical crop; the left edge of the desk also enters this central crop near the bottom. Keep the upper 70% focused on city and water, maintain a large restful view. Wide landscape, full bleed, no border.
Lighting/mood: Blue hour evening, deep steel blue and charcoal, many softly glowing warm windows across the city and amber reflections across the waterfront. Light drizzle, wistful stillness, subtle room warmth from a concealed indirect source, physically realistic exposure and reflections.
Constraints: No visible people, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no app UI, no posters. No conspicuous glowing lamp bulb and no lit desk lamp; lamp illumination will be layered by the app. Not cyberpunk, not fantasy, not futuristic. Original architectural scene; do not copy stock photographs or reproduce recognizable landmarks. Photoreal cinematic photography, not illustration, not a UI mockup.
